claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Artemis II crew will be recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
Live coverage begins at 6:30 p.m. EDT on NASA+, the NASA app, and NASA's YouTube channel.
The Artemis II Orion capsule will undergo a "lofted entry" to reduce heating.
The Artemis II Orion service module will separate roughly 20 minutes before atmospheric entry.
